flags.text: Profit compounding faster than sales over 3y (17.3% vs 11.9%): operating leverage
Operating margin up 200 bps over 3 years
Cash conversion strong: 5y operating cash = 164% of profit

guidance.promise: Reach 0.8x to 0.9x net debt to EBITDA by end of fiscal year
guidance.quote: I believe and I'm very confident that we'll reach the mark of 1x and be in 0.8, 0.9x net debt EBITDA by the end of this fiscal year.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Launch cable and wires products in October-December 2026 quarter
guidance.quote: civil work has started, and we are on schedule to see the launch of our product in the October-December '26 quarter as was committed earlier.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Add approximately 8 to 9 million tons capacity in Q4
guidance.quote: So, we should have approximately 8 to 9 million tons more coming in this quarter.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Add 12 million tons capacity in fiscal '27
guidance.quote: And the balance,12 million tons in fiscal '27 and then balance remaining will be in '28.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Reach total capacity of 235 million tons by FY '28
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

claims.claim: Operating at more than 90% of existing installed capacity in January-March quarter
claims.quote: January-March quarter, God willing, we will operate at more than 90% of our existing installed capacity

claims.claim: Kesoram brand conversion reached 69% in December '25
claims.quote: brand conversion at Kesoram having reached 69% in December '25.

claims.claim: Lead distance dropped to 363 kilometers and clinker conversion factor improved to 1.49
claims.quote: you would have noticed the lead distance has dropped to 363 kilometers. The clinker conversion factor has improved to 1.49.

claims.claim: India Cements brand conversion crossed 58% at the end of December '25
claims.quote: India Cements has already crossed 58% at the end of December '25.

pushback.topic: Pricing pressure and sustainability of price hikes
pushback.quote: What do you think industry's stance will be in this kind of a high expansion scenario?

pushback.topic: Southern India volatile cement pricing dynamics
pushback.quote: What in your view needs to change in industry dynamics in South for pricing to be more stable with upward bias?

pushback.topic: India Cements non-core asset sales and legal issues
pushback.quote: Sir, third question on India Cements. Anything on non-core asset sale? And any thoughts on merger, basically simplifying the structure? Any time lines around that?

calls.tone: Confident, bullish, and highly optimistic about demand growth and operational efficiencies.

guidance.promise: Invest around 8,000 crores to 10,000 crores every year for the foreseeable future
guidance.quote: We see a plan of investing around INR8,000 crores to INR10,000 crores every year for the foreseeable future.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Sustainable volume growth of 7% to 8% per annum
guidance.quote: We expect a sustainable volume growth of 7% to 8% per annum.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Reach about 85% of power requirements from green energy by end of fiscal 2030
guidance.quote: We have committed to reach about 85% of our power requirements from green energy by the end of fiscal 2030
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Add a further 37 million tons taking capacity over 242.5 million tons by fiscal 28
guidance.quote: We have committed to add a further 37 million tons, which will take us over 242.5 million tons in a phased manner by fiscal '28.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Maintain leverage below 1x year after year after meeting growth capex
guidance.quote: We'll maintain our leverage below 1x year after year after meeting our growth capex.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

claims.claim: Crossed 200 million tons of cement production capacity in India
claims.quote: UltraTech crossed 200 million tons of cement production capacity in India, a first for any company in a single country outside of China.

claims.claim: Completed 100% brand migration for India Cements and Kesoram at end of March 26
claims.quote: Brand migration - 100% brand migration has been completed at the end of March '26.

claims.claim: Consolidated sales volumes crossed 44 million tons this quarter
claims.quote: Consolidated sales volumes, as you have already seen, has crossed a rocking 44 million tons this quarter.

pushback.topic: West Asia conflict impact and cost pressures
pushback.quote: Sir, secondly, I'm just following up on the question from the previous participant on the Slide 6 where you speak about the impact of West Asia conflict.

pushback.topic: Cement price hikes versus other building materials
pushback.quote: Sir, one question we keep on getting from investors over the last few months is that the other industries, industries like steel and agri and PVC has taken aggressive price hike in the face of cost pressures.

pushback.topic: Special dividend payout sustainability and balance sheet usage
pushback.quote: So Satyadeep Jain: Yes. Thank you. Mr. Daga, just a follow-up question on the dividend. Heartening to see that special dividend.

calls.tone: Confident, bullish, highly disciplined and transparent regarding integration and capital return.

guidance.promise: Deploy INR17,000 crores capex in the next 2 to 2.5 years for capacity growth
guidance.quote: Projects under execution for capacity growth are backed by a capex of about INR17,000 crores in the next 2 to 2.5 years.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: End the year with net debt to EBITDA below 1x
guidance.quote: Our belief is, and we are confident that this year also, we'll end the net debt to EBITDA below 1x.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Target double-digit volume growth this fiscal year
guidance.quote: Yes, we are targeting double-digit volume growth this year.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Commission Cables and Wires product launch in Q3 fiscal 27
guidance.quote: We reaffirm commissioning and product launch in Q3 fiscal '27, October - December '26 quarter, precisely as committed to you
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Reach INR1,000 per ton EBITDA for India Cements by Q4 fiscal 28
guidance.quote: an EBITDA of INR1,000 per ton for India Cements remains very much in sight with the full benefit of the capex program flowing through the P&L from Q4 fiscal '28.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

claims.claim: Achieved highest ever first quarter performance across volumes, revenues, EBITDA and profit.
claims.quote: Q1 was the highest ever first quarter performance for UltraTech across volumes, revenues, EBITDA and profit.

claims.claim: Domestic grey cement volume grew 13.1% in Q1.
claims.quote: Our domestic grey cement volumes growth of 13.1%, I believe will be well ahead of industry's growth, translating directly into market share gains.

claims.claim: Capacity utilization improved to 81% in Q1.
claims.quote: Capacity utilization was stronger at 81% as compared to 76%

claims.claim: Completed 100% brand conversion for Kesoram and India Cements to UltraTech.
claims.quote: Interestingly, I'm very proud to tell you, we have converted the Kesoram and India Cements brands to 100% UltraTech.

pushback.quote: So how do you think this growing cash flow will get utilized across dividends, cement capex? And is there any plan to scale up the cables and wires building material capex further?
And I know things are still volatile, but any guidance for the next quarter that may come up in terms of cost?

pushback.topic: Volume growth and pricing power sustainability
pushback.quote: Now if we look at other large players, they are able to either prioritize volumes or they prioritize pricing. But in your case, despite your base, you have been gaining share on both sides.

calls.tone: Confident, bullish, consistent, and assertive regarding market dominance and delivery execution.

guidance.promise: Maintain FY27 capex guidance at around INR10,000 crores
guidance.quote: I will still stick to INR10,000, but it will be better to look at a full year number after the Q3 results. Plus minus INR10,000 crores.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Reduce net debt to EBITDA below 1x by end of March
guidance.quote: We are at 1.26x net debt EBITDA at the end of September '26. But by the end of March, I will be below 1x net debt to EBITDA.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

guidance.promise: Reach 240 million tons of cement capacity as planned without surprises
guidance.quote: We are on track to reach 240 million tons of capacity as planned without surprises.
guidance.speaker: K.C. Jhanwar

guidance.promise: Deliver INR1,400 EBITDA per ton by March 2028 vision
guidance.quote: Business as usual is what my expectation is to deliver that INR1,400. If the cost pressures come in, they will get covered by price increases. So yes, we will deliver our commitment.
guidance.speaker: Atul Daga

claims.claim: Achieved 13.8% volume growth and 21% net profit increase this quarter.
claims.quote: As for UltraTech, despite increase in cost, the company has achieved an improvement in operating performance... and a 21% increase in net profit.

claims.claim: Commissioned 4.6 million tons of capacity in September taking domestic capacity to 204.7 million tons.
claims.quote: We commissioned 4.6 million tons of capacity in the month of September, taking our domestic cement capacity to 204.7 million tons

claims.claim: Added 116 megawatts of renewable power and 10 megawatt of waste heat recovery during the quarter.
claims.quote: During the quarter, also added 116 megawatts of renewable power, 10 megawatt of waste heat recovery.

pushback.topic: Fuel and variable cost inflation outlook
pushback.quote: First, if we were to take spot costs across all front, fuel, industrial diesel, etcetera, what kind of variable cost inflation can we see in the second half from the current levels?

pushback.topic: Wires and Cables strategy and pricing
pushback.quote: Second question on Ultravolt. Any change in strategy over there to enter into cables or broad consumer electrical segment? And how are we pricing the current wires versus the existing players?

pushback.topic: Sustainability of INR1,400 EBITDA per ton target amidst cost inflation
pushback.quote: We had a INR1,400 EBITDA per ton exit March '28 vision or guidance. Do we assume that it would be on hold until we see the peak of cost inflation behind us?

calls.tone: Confident, transparent, and optimistic about strong demand, pricing momentum, and cost management.

credibility.line: Management delivers volume targets and capex plans, but struggles to hit net debt to EBITDA reduction goals.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management stated net debt to EBITDA would drop below 1x by March, but reported 1.26x at September '26.
Reported financial data shows borrowings rose 2.6x from INR11,403 crores in Mar 2024 to INR29,289 crores in Sep 2026.
Operating cash flow strength is supported by 5y cash conversion at 1.64x of profit.

bull: Consolidated annual revenue grew to INR88,512 crores in FY26.
Strong 5-year operating cash flow conversion at 1.64x of profit.
Domestic grey cement volume grew 13.1% in Q1 FY27.
bear: Borrowings increased significantly to INR29,289 crores in Sep 2026 from INR11,403 crores in Mar 2024.
Net debt to EBITDA stood at 1.26x in September '26, missing targets.
Equity decreased from INR76,624 crores in Mar 2026 to INR73,588 crores in Sep 2026.
